Page 328 
Chenodiol Products 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-355242  
Guideline Name 
Chenodiol Products  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
9/1/2025  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Chenodal*  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or verification of paid claims confirming 
ALL of the following:  
 
 1.1 Diagnosis of radiolucent gallstones  


--- PDF page 329 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 329 
 
AND 
 
 1.2 Patient has a well-opacifying gallbladder visualized by oral cholecystography  
 
AND 
 
 1.3 Trial and failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ursodiol  
 
AND 
 
 1.4 Patient is not a candidate for surgery  
 
AND 
 
 1.5 Stones are not calcified (radiopaque) or radiolucent bile pigment stones  
 
AND 
 
2 - Prescribed by or in consultation with ONE of the following:  
• 
Gastroenterologist  
• 
A provider who has specialized expertise in the management of gallstones  
Notes  
*If patient meets criteria above, please approve at NDC level. 
 
Product Name:Chenodal*  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    


--- PDF page 330 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 330 
 
1 - Patient’s disease status has been re-evaluated since the last authorization to confirm the 
patient’s condition warrants continued treatment as evidenced by oral cholecystograms or 
ultrasonograms  
 
AND 
 
2 - Prescribed by or in consultation with ONE of the following:  
• 
Gastroenterologist  
• 
A provider who has specialized expertise in the management of gallstones  
Notes  
*If patient meets criteria above, please approve at NDC level. 
 
Product Name:Ctexli^  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming ALL of the following:  
 
 1.1 Diagnosis of cerebrotendinous xanthomatosis (cholestanol storage disease)  
 
AND 
 
 1.2 Disease is confirmed by the presence of pathogenic variant(s) in the CYP27A1 gene, as 
detected by an FDA (Food and Drug Administration)-approved test or a test performed at a 
facility approved by Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA)  
 
AND 
 
2 - Prescribed by or in consultation with ONE of the following:  
• 
Neurologist  
• 
Geneticist  


--- PDF page 331 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 331 
• 
Metabolic disease specialist  
Notes  
^If patient meets criteria above, please approve at NDC level. 
 
Product Name:Ctexli^  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient demonstrates positive clinical response to therapy (e.g., stabilization or 
improvement in symptoms, reduction in biochemical markers [e.g., serum cholestanol, urine 
23S-pentol])  
Notes  
^If patient meets criteria above, please approve at NDC level.
